notes.text: ניולי is retained as the unexplained headword Niyuli. The notice does not determine whether it is a personal name or another term. Earlier machine OCR read גיולי; this does not establish a printed variant.
Rav Huna’s title רב is written in full. Chullin 45b follows מה: under the colon convention; the notice supplies no statement content.
The cited occurrence has not been independently checked here.
